Pattern: Every boot-doc tool invocation must be CWD-PROOF. A bare root-relative (`python3 scripts/x.py`) or own-dir-relative path silently depends on the incidental shell cwd and fails rc=2 from the actual own-dir launch cwd (`cd AGENTS/<NAME> && claude`). Wrap runnable boot commands as `python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/<path>"` (self-locating scripts) or `(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)[/<dir>]" && <cmd>)` (path-dependent commands); scripts self-locate data via __file__. Never leave a runnable boot line depending on incidental cwd.

Pattern: STATUS BANNERS ROT WHEN THE COMPLETING ACTION HAPPENS ON A DIFFERENT SURFACE THAN THE BANNER -- a write-back gap, RECIPROCAL by nature. CROSS-AGENT sub-case: agent B disposes/applies agent A's ROUTED work, updates B's own + the target surface, but never writes back to A's ORIGINATING doc -> A's banner lies. SELF sub-case: an agent completes work in surface X but never updates the status banner in its own surface Y. FIX BOTH SIDES: (disposer) write a completion note to the originator's inbox AT disposition-time -- a sanctioned expected reply, not an unsolicited write per [[feedback_cross_agent_inbox_writes]]; (originator) reconcile originating banners at boot. The disposer write-back is PRIMARY (it lands in the inbox the originator already reads at boot); the boot-diff is the BACKSTOP.

Pattern: A staleness ENFORCER is only as good as (a) the SURFACE it points at and (b) whether it recognizes the fleet's ACTUAL 'declared-static' vocabulary + POSITION. Fix additively: point the enforcer at the at-risk surface + recognize a header-BLOCK vocabulary set, non-breaking for existing callers.
Evidence: 7/4 TRADE-staleness sweep (PAT-025): scripts/ledger_staleness.py globbed workbook/*.tsv only + is_frozen matched literal FROZEN via readline() (line 1). Live-verified: --glob TRADE.md flagged REGINALD +63d (surface enforceable, merely unenforced); CARL/MARCO would latently false-flag once aged past threshold. Fixed: --trade flag + header-block recognizer (FROZEN|RETIRED|NOT CURRENT|DO NOT CITE|NOT MAINTAINED|ARCHIVED); validated non-breaking (workbook --all output byte-identical for the 6 callers).
Notes: Generalizes mechanism-over-discipline (PAT-023): when you BUILD an enforcer, verify it (a) covers the surface the rule targets and (b) recognizes the compliance signal in the forms the fleet actually uses -- else it is theater that reads as coverage. Relates PAT-023 (staleness banner-or-alert rule), PAT-031 (cwd-proof: the sibling 'mechanism must match the real launch reality' fix), [[finding_fail_loud_on_incomplete_data]], [[finding_script_labels_match_thesis]]. Pattern: To make a RECURRING autonomous maintenance task safely low-friction, pre-approve ONLY its reversible + machine-verifiable mutation sub-class and keep every other disposition gated. The pre-grant covers 'permission' for a BOUNDED class while the per-action gate still runs each time (here: freeze-only, on idle-verified dead surfaces, always logged; ambiguous idle-check -> fall back to ask). This delegates the mechanical action without eroding the two-guard authority model (permission + idle) -- the opposite of a blank check.
Evidence: 7/4 Fleet Staleness Sweep institutionalization: Will granted DAEDALUS standing pre-approval for the dormant-freeze sub-class only (freeze-only / idle-verified via no-self-authored-commits+STATUS-older-than-cadence / logged+reported / reversible); live-agent routing + ledger_staleness.py patches stay per-run gated. Without the pre-grant the recurring task stalls on an approval round-trip for its most mechanical, harmless action; with a blank check it erodes the AUTHORITY guards.
Notes: Governs the recurring-maintenance model (sweeps/). Generalizes: when institutionalizing ANY autonomous recurring agent task, split dispositions into {reversible+auto-verifiable -> pre-approve} vs {consequential/ambiguous -> gate}. Relates [[finding_subagent_escalation_mode_discriminator]] (money=block on Will), the AUTHORITY two-guard model (permission+idle), PAT-034 (boot-cadence). The idle-verification test = the same self-authored-vs-routing-commit discriminator used to grade dormancy.

Pattern: SUBSTANCE-IN-CODE INVISIBILITY: analytical substance (convergence logic, threshold ladders, exit rules, predictions-resolution) encoded as EXECUTABLE SCRIPT rather than markdown prose is structurally invisible to a STATUS/CLAUDE markdown scan -> script-heavy agents are systematically under-rated. Distinct from PAT-020 (substance at a non-standard PATH): here the substance is in a non-markdown MEDIUM. Tell: a large scripts/ dir + a low mechanical grade -> read the scripts BEFORE grading.
Evidence: 7/4 VIOLET+LIQUID Mode-A firming: BOTH 2-level under-rates (L2->L4). VIOLET's 8-script quant engine (convexity pricing rubric w/ forecast-vs-expression split, 19yr/4811-obs backtest, regime-termination/skew-trajectory pair) + LIQUID's 600-ln boot.py (3 dashboards w/ coded threshold ladders, CCC-BB tail-gap composite, schema-validating selftest, predictions due-scan) held §2/§3/§4/§5 substance the markdown scan never saw. Both scans said 'L2 mechanical-only'.
Notes: Extends PAT-020 path-blindness -> medium-blindness. The judgment-read (a fan-out reader over scripts/) is the designed backstop, NOT a scanner rewrite; optional maturity_scan.py heuristic = flag {substantial scripts/ dir AND sub-L3 mechanical grade} as PROVISIONAL-pending-code-read (mirrors PAT-024's provisional-L3+ rule). Relates PAT-009, PAT-020, PAT-024.

Pattern: The mechanical scan's NEGATIVE gap-notes are reliable ONLY for a genuinely-absent LABELED HANDLE (a specific heading that binarily exists or not), NOT for SUBSTANCE claims. 'no BOTTOM LINE' (a heading) checks out; 'no conv-matrix'/'exit-rules lack session counts' (substance that can live in thesis/scripts/workbook) is unreliable. Triage: TRUST missing-labeled-handle flags; RE-VERIFY (never propagate) missing-substance flags.
Evidence: 7/4 VIOLET+LIQUID: 'exit-rules lack session counts' FALSE for both (VIOLET = 3 N+session rules incl a live tally; LIQUID = 13+ instances); 'no conv-matrix' HALF-false (substance present in code/KILL_MEMO, only the universal 5-pt HANDLE absent); 'no BOTTOM LINE' TRUE for both. The only reliable negative was the labeled-handle absence.
Notes: Operationalizes PAT-024 into a per-claim triage rule for firming; pairs w/ PAT-022 (handle-vs-substance gap-typing) -- the scan can SEE a missing handle, cannot see present-but-scattered substance. So when a scan row lists 3 negatives, expect ~1 (the handle) to survive the read. Relates PAT-009, PAT-024, PAT-033.

Pattern: A git-commit-time staleness enforcer goes FALSE-CLEAN on flattened history: any clone/import/squash that collapses commit dates (shallow clone, repo import, history truncation) makes every ledger read "+0d ok" regardless of content age -- the enforcer is environment-dependent, not just surface/vocabulary-dependent (extends PAT-035 a/b with (c) TIMEBASE). In-content dates (row dates, Last_Updated cols, header stamps) are the only portable staleness signal; a reader grading from a cloud/ephemeral clone must grade from content dates and SAY SO.
Evidence: OTTO read 7/7 from a Claude-Code-app cloud clone (history truncated ~50 commits, every OTTO file sharing one 2026-07-06 commit date): ledger_staleness.py read +0d/ok for KB (content Mar-26), CROSS_AGENT_LOG (Apr-15), EXTENSION_PROXY (Apr-14) -- 11-15wk content-stale. On Will's boxes (full history) the same reads are correct; OTTO's own boot alert tracks the backlog there.
Notes: Operational consequence NOW: Will runs sessions from the cloud app -- any agent booting there gets false-clean staleness reads; treat cloud-session staleness output as UNRELIABLE-CLEAN (a FROZEN/stale flag is still trustworthy; an "ok" is not). Candidate mechanism fix (gated, ledger_staleness.py is shared): fall back to in-file date columns when git times are uniform/degenerate. 2ND INSTANCE 7/10 (REGINALD, self-found during banner pass): ANY hygiene edit (two-clock header, STALE-VINTAGE banner) resets the git clock -> enforcer reads ~0d and STOPS flagging the very surface just marked stale — the banner SILENCES the auto-nag until staleness re-accrues. The timebase weakness is now 2nd-surface (cloud-clone flatten + hygiene-edit reset) -> the fix graduates from candidate to PROPOSE: teach ledger_staleness.py to parse a "Last real data refresh: <date>" header (the PAT-044 two-clock form) and prefer it over git-time when present. Gated (shared script, 6+ callers). Relates PAT-035 (enforcer-theater), PAT-023.

Pattern: A DELETION sweep for manual-steps-superseded-by-script can return its INVERSE: the fleet had already deleted manual steps when wiring boot kits (the sweep found ONE stale covers-clause), but 4 of 15 orchestrators were INSTALLED-BUT-UNWIRED -- the script existed while the boot protocol never invoked it (one agent even ran a TWIN of a script its orchestrator carried). The step is not stale beside the mechanism; the MECHANISM is stale beside the steps. When auditing manual-vs-script duplication, check BOTH directions: steps the script covers AND scripts no step invokes.
Evidence: S3 sweep 7/8: SAM/BRENT/CORAL/LABOR/LIQUID/RED/VIOLET/YEYOU/MARCO/OTTO all already-folded (LIQUID: "replaces the manual fetch.py calls"); CARL (6-monitor boot.py unwired + catalyst_countdown vs docket_countdown twin), HAWK (5-monitor, CLAUDE.md zero refs), HENRY (FILES table says "run at boot", boot list never invokes), REGINALD (zero refs) = 4 unwired orchestrators, inbox-flagged wire-or-retire.
Notes: Extends PAT-034 (installed-but-unexercised) from consumer-side handles to boot MECHANISMS, and PAT-035 enforcer-theater to orchestrator-theater (a boot kit that exists but never runs reads as automation coverage). Sweep discipline: verify invocation-presence (grep "boot.py" in the boot doc) as a cheap first check before reading either side. Wire-or-retire = the same two-state rule as ledgers.

Pattern: A same-session build wave lands TOOLS reliably but homes their CADENCE on volatile surfaces — the recurring trigger gets written into the session's own handoff medium (SCRATCH full-rewrite files, STATUS prose, docstrings) instead of a durable one (boot.py sequence, CATALYSTS/docket rows, CLAUDE.md FILES+boot steps). RULE: a recurring trigger must live one durability class ABOVE the session that created it, else the tool is one dropped rewrite away from installed-but-unwired (PAT-040).
Evidence: 7/9 Tier-3 build wave review (7/10, 4-reader): 3 of 4 builds flagged — LABOR form4_scanner 7/20 re-run in STATUS prose + PROME packet but NOT in docket/CATALYSTS.tsv (LABOR's own "catalyst source of truth"); LABOR job_postings_tracker weekly series with no cadence anywhere; ORACLE disruption_supply_spread "run every session" homed in SCRATCH.md (full-rewrite-every-closeout per its CLAUDE.md:47) + CLAUDE.md FILES table not updated. Counter-example same wave: SAM gpif_flows wired boot.py row + CLAUDE.md step-7 + FILES in one session = the reference pattern.
Notes: Extends PAT-040 (installed-but-unwired) with the MECHANISM of how it happens at build-time: wiring debt is born in the build session, not accreted later. Grading/build-review check: for every new recurring tool ask "where does the NEXT session learn to run this?" — if the answer is a file that gets rewritten or rolls off, flag it. BAKED into blueprints 2026-07-10 (market §8 bullet + utility §5 discipline; meta N/A — sweeps/REGISTRY.tsv already registry-governs; EVOLUTION 7/10 entry).

Pattern: CLASSIFICATION-LABEL DRIFT: a fleet-level roster label (the one-phrase domain descriptor) can drift from the agent's OWN charter — and everything downstream inherits the LABEL, not the charter: graders rubric against the wrong domain, routers send the wrong signals, peer STATUS files restate the error, and even DAEDALUS's own reader-tasking prompts propagate it. Before grading or routing to any agent, verify the domain from its CLAUDE.md identity section, never from the roster one-liner.
Evidence: HANS firming 7/10: fleet-wide label "geopolitics-energy" (PROME/ROSTER.md:46 + FLEET_MAP note + HENRY/STATUS.md:119) vs HANS's actual charter = European macro via US-market lens (CLAUDE.md:3,10; military explicitly ceded to HAWK :92). DAEDALUS's own reader prompt inherited the wrong label from the row it was firming. The mislabel also fed the "is HANS absorbed by HAWK/BRENT?" retirement question — which dissolved once the real charter was read (distinct Europe lane, no other owner).
Notes: Fix at the OWNER surface per PAT-006 (ROSTER = PROME's file — flagged, not edited; FLEET_MAP note = own file, fixed 7/10; HENRY restatement = HENRY's next boot). Grading discipline: profile/firming reads START from the agent's identity section. Sibling of PAT-038 (don't trust scan negatives) at the classification layer: don't trust the roster one-liner either. Relates [[finding_verify_roster_by_commit_activity]] (activity), PAT-006 (single-home facts) — this extends both to the DOMAIN-DESCRIPTOR field. Relates PAT-034, PAT-035, PAT-040, [[finding_closeout_as_writeback_tail]].

Pattern: NESTED SUB-AGENT LAYERS DECAY FROM THE DURABLE END: live surfaces (STATUS/state-vectors) keep working while instruction files (CLAUDE.md threshold "Current" values, file counts, protocol paths) and workbook TSVs/KB fossilize at build vintage — the refresh loop touches only what the session template makes convenient. Tell: mtime SPREAD inside one sub-agent dir (STATUS fresh, CLAUDE/TSVs at build date). Nested layers sit outside every fleet staleness enforcer (ledger_staleness.py does not glob sub_agents/*/workbook/) and outside prediction due-scans — rot is structurally invisible until read.
Evidence: CARL sub-agent audit 7/10 (4-reader, all 8 dirs): STUE 4 TSVs untouched at its own Jun-9 refresh; HOMER canonical KB.tsv (delegation contract for 47 CARL KB rows) dead since Apr-29 while dashboards moved; every CLAUDE.md carried hardcoded Feb-Apr "Current" values + the dangling ../SHARED/ template path; ~27 sub-agent predictions past/near resolvers with no due-scan (GIG P01 a resolvable MISS 54d unresolved).
Notes: Sibling of PAT-032/PAT-035 at the nested layer. Template-origin defects stamp into EVERY child (audit found 3 classes fleet-wide-within-CARL). Grading rule: when an agent runs nested sub-agents, audit the CHILD layer's durable surfaces separately — parent-level health does not imply child-layer health. PARENT-LEVEL INSTANCE CONFIRMED 7/10: REGINALD self-audit found the identical decay shape at the TOP level of the fleet's heaviest agent — STATUS.md live/current while thesis/THESIS.md (v1.4 Apr-16), TIMELINE (Apr-2), WAL/INDEX cold-boot entry (v2.0 May-1), BANK_EXPOSURE_MATRIX (Feb-23) + ~40/61 VX rows fossilized pre-Q1/Q2-arc, asserting an INVERTED picture (CRITICAL vs 🟠, WAL below-$78 vs $80.69). The pattern is fleet-general, not nested-layer-specific: refresh loops touch the surface the session template makes convenient (STATUS), durable thesis-of-record surfaces rot. Candidate mechanism: extend staleness/due-scan globs one level down. Relates PAT-023, PAT-034, PAT-035, PAT-041.

Pattern: A FRESHNESS LEDGER KEYED ON DELIVERABLE-RECEIPT LAUNDERS BYPASSES: if the coordinator marks a child "fresh" when a report/SV ARRIVES rather than when the child's canonical surfaces UPDATE, a parent-side catch-up that ships one outbox file flips the row green while the canonical surface rots — worse than no ledger, because the green badge suppresses the respawn that would fix it. Freshness must key on the canonical surface's own state (mtime/in-file date), never on receipt of a derived artifact.
Evidence: CARL TEAM.md:16 marked GIG "fresh (Jun 22)" off outbox/SV-GIG-2026-06-22-01.md (a CARL-side catch-up gather, not a GIG session); GIG STATUS/workbook stayed Apr-17 and TODAY assert falsified facts (FL-gas thesis leg INVERTED — $3.617 below natl vs STATUS "above"; Dave canary reframed; CRL-08 breach unrecorded). SPAWN_PROTOCOL:203's own canon ("not in STATUS or a TSV = didn't happen") says the refresh never happened — yet the roster said fresh.
Notes: The nested-layer instance of PAT-035 enforcer-theater (the "enforcer" here is a hand-written roster). Fix = derive freshness mechanically from canonical-surface state (CARL docket #7c boot.py mtime job) + the write-back-down-or-BYPASSED-stamp rule (docket #9d). Relates PAT-032 (write-back gap), PAT-035, PAT-040, [[finding_asymmetric_records_need_reconciliation]]. FIX-FORM OBSERVED 7/10 (CARL in-flight tag-pass, reviewed live): TWO-CLOCK HEADER — "Last real data refresh: <d1> | Staleness sweep (no data): <d2> | Next: <catalyst>" + tag-only stale-vintage banner ("tag-only sweep — no web pulls, no value updates") — separates the data clock from the hygiene clock so a hygiene pass CANNOT launder freshness. Candidate blueprint line (market §8 + sub-agent templates).

Pattern: STATELESS ON-DEMAND AGENTS LEARN THROUGH A RUN-RETROSPECTIVE LOOP, NOT STATE FILES: mandatory per-run Process Report -> closeout promotion-scan aggregating recurrences into BACKLOG/auto-memory -> periodic debrief to coordinator -> disposition -> SAME-WEEK encoding into the agent spec. This substitutes for the monitor-agent workbook/predictions machinery (which would only rot on an on-demand agent) and pairs with an EXPLICIT written anti-default ("INDEX.tsv is deliberately the only state file; add machinery only on demonstrated need") so future sessions do not re-add monitor scaffolding by template gravity.
Evidence: DEWEY 7/9-7/10: 8-item debrief dispositioned by PROME/Will + implemented <24h (run protocol encoded 214b47bf, trace_bond built 65226246); 7/10 drafts = the loop running again (engine-sizing, return-partial guardrail, rate-limit recovery, BUILD GATE) each anchored to a specific named run failure. CLAUDE.md closeout step 8 carries the written anti-default.
Notes: The utility-blueprint answer for on-demand/Tier-2 agents: PAT-014 (OTTO archive->rules) is the CONTINUOUS-agent learning loop; PAT-045 is the ON-DEMAND analog (per-run retrospective, no standing ledgers beyond the run-index). Candidate utility-agent.md line. Relates PAT-001 (anti-DARWIN), PAT-041 (the BUILD-GATE trigger still needs a durable home - N2 in the DEWEY review), [[finding_deep_research_primary_pull_owns_three_data_classes]].

Pattern: ROOT-CANON BEHAVIORAL RULES DO NOT RELIABLY BIND SPAWNED TEAMS-MODE AGENTS — the spawn PROMPT must carry them explicitly. A named spawned agent can execute its work perfectly and still violate a root/agent-CLAUDE behavioral contract (deliver-result-before-idle) because the rule lived in ambient context, not its task prompt. Files-are-the-contract is the safety net (work recoverable from disk), but the coordinator still pays a chase/verify cost. RULE: every teams-mode spawn prompt template ends with an explicit delivery clause (SendMessage result to coordinator AND write to disk BEFORE idling), plus any other root behavioral gate the task touches.
Evidence: CARL 7/10 orchestration: named-GIG agent applied its ratification work correctly but idled WITHOUT sending its report — CARL verified from disk (write-back item, inbox 655089c2). Sibling instance same day: DAEDALUS ECHO died post-deliverable (verified complete only because the file was on disk). Root CLAUDE.md carries the deliver-before-idle rule; both agents missed it from ambient context.
Notes: Orchestration-layer sibling of PAT-031 (cwd-proof: do not depend on incidental context) applied to spawn prompts. Candidate: bake a standing delivery-clause line into the meta-agent blueprint orchestration section + any spawn-prompt template. Relates [[finding_fence_orchestration_live_agent]], [[feedback_subagent_prompt_discipline]], PAT-004 (live-session guards), PAT-032 (write-back gaps).

Pattern: NEW-AGENT REGISTRATION SPLITS ACROSS TWO OWNERS AND MUST CO-REGISTER: existence lives in PROME/ROSTER.md (PROME home dir — DAEDALUS cannot commit it per the git shared-file rule) while class/maturity lives in FLEET_MAP.tsv (DAEDALUS). render_directory.py FAILS LOUD on a FLEET_MAP agent absent from ROSTER (the co-registration guard). So on a build: route ROSTER + root CLAUDE + AGENTS.md registration to PROME as a packet with EXACT insert text, and HOLD the own-side FLEET_MAP row + FLEET_DIRECTORY regen until PROME lands the ROSTER row — then add both in one pass. Never add the FLEET_MAP row first (breaks your own directory render).
Evidence: WATT+VULCAN+MIDAS builds 7/10-11: all 3 scaffolded + agent-tree-wired directly, but ROSTER/root/AGENTS.md routed to PROME (3 packets) and FLEET_MAP/directory held. render_directory.py:120-124 dies on unhandled FLEET_MAP-only agent.
Notes: Generalizes the AEOLUS wiring (where DAEDALUS edited ROSTER directly — pre-dated the hard shared-file-commit discipline). The render guard (my own fail-loud) enforces the co-registration; the git rule enforces who commits ROSTER. The two combine to a deferred-FLEET_MAP handshake. Relates PAT-006 (one-owner-per-fact), PAT-019 (new agent = no commit history), the git shared-file rule.

Pattern: LAUNCH INSTRUMENT-LIGHT WHEN THE DAY-1 FETCH IS UNTESTED OR THE CHANNELS AREN'T PER-BOOT — do NOT ship an unverified scraper at build time to hit a 'complete agent' bar. Split by instrument-readiness: WATT INHERITED a tested instrument (power_watch.py, moved + smoke-tested rc 0) so it wired it into boot.py; VULCAN (quarterly earnings cadence) + MIDAS (yfinance futures errored on test) launched boot.py = staleness+predictions-due only, with the fetch (semi_watch/metals_watch) flagged as the PRIORITY FIRST INCREMENT in SCRATCH + LESSONS, PAT-041-wired when built. A boot.py that runs an untested instrument fails LOUD (rc 2) on day 1 and reads as a broken agent.
Evidence: 3-agent build 7/10-11: WATT boot.py rc 0 w/ live power_watch; VULCAN+MIDAS boot.py rc 0 staleness+predictions only (VULCAN no instrument by design; MIDAS real-yield via FRED worked but GC=F spot errored -> deferred to a validated metals_watch.py). All three boot-verified before wiring.
Notes: Extends PAT-041 (durable cadence home) with a build-SEQUENCING rule: verify the instrument BEFORE wiring it into boot; if not ready, launch instrument-light + flag it, don't force it. A newborn agent's value can be its structure + seams alone (VULCAN/MIDAS) — the instrument is a fast-follow, not a launch gate. Relates PAT-041, PAT-040 (installed-but-unwired), the verify-the-build discipline.

Pattern: A DOMAIN-AGENT-AUTHORED SPLIT SPEC IS RELIABLE ON THE ANALYTICAL CORE, BLIND ON THE OPERATIONAL PERIPHERY — and ambiguous on "freeze." HAWK's split spec was verified row-accurate on VX/predictions/scenario constructs (18/18 VX agree), but entirely missed board_log.tsv, DECK_EVIDENCE.md, CALENDAR.md, the stale scripts suite, and gave NO row mapping for FLOW (8/20 ambiguous); "freeze-in-place" left dead-ledger vs no-row-surgery unresolved (KB/board_log/PREDICTIONS stayed LIVE under the residual agent; only truly-superseded surfaces got FROZEN banners). Reader fan-out over the FULL file tree BEFORE build is the closing mechanism; the build spec must ratify per-surface dispositions the domain spec never mentions.
Evidence: OSPREY/FALCON build 7/12: MANIFEST_A found 2 unaddressed operational surfaces + a 3-owner single-table disaggregation; MANIFEST_B built the missing FLOW mapping + found KB dup-IDs; MANIFEST_C found stale preamble + 5 missing archive post-mortems + THESIS.md 100%-one-theater (spec implied surgery, reality = wholesale move).
Notes: Extends PAT-021/PAT-035 to the SPLIT/migration class. Companion rule: at re-cut time, banner the ORIGINALS of any file copied to a successor (two live-looking copies = silent-rot; THESIS/TIMELINE/CHANGELOG/RUSSIA_OIL_INFRA bannered by DAEDALUS post-WP-3). Relates PAT-016 (section-not-whole-agent), PAT-047 (co-registration), PAT-048 (instrument-light).

Pattern: THE ARCHITECT'S OWN SURFACES ROT IN EXACTLY THE CLASSES IT POLICES — pattern-enforcement runs outward by default, never inward. Every HIGH in the 7/12 self-sweep was a previously-banked pattern applied fleet-wide but not to DAEDALUS's own files: own FLEET_MAP row = the fleet's LAST un-re-scored row (L3 for 2wks while STATUS claimed L4 — PAT-024 inward); 6 cards + a batch banner stale on landed dispositions (PAT-032 inward); Build-progress table + EVOLUTION roadmap fossilized under a fresh lead (PAT-043 inward); 9 dead outbox files w/ no delivered/ (the root Data-Hygiene dead-mail class — while scaffolding outbox/delivered/ into every agent built). ROOT CAUSE = asymmetric plumbing, not discipline: inbound write-backs closed the FLEET_MAP leg only (protocol named no card/batch/outbox legs), and no sweep scoped the sweeper.
Evidence: DAEDALUS self-sweep 2026-07-12 (Will-directed, 4-reader fan-out, upgrades/DAEDALUS_SELF_SWEEP_2026-07-12.md): 33 findings, 11 HIGH, ~all record-lag on own surfaces; zero orphaned decisions. Readers grep-verified every HIGH against live files.
Notes: FIXES INSTALLED same-day (Will-approved): self-inclusion clauses in all 3 sweep playbooks (DAEDALUS in scope); SPAWN-7 write-back TAIL rule (close card+batch+outbox legs, not just FLEET_MAP); profile-trigger check added to Production Review step 2; own outbox/delivered/ created + 11 files archived. GRADING RULE: when auditing a meta/coordinator agent, audit its TRACKING LAYER against its own enforced patterns first — that is where it rots. Relates PAT-024, PAT-032, PAT-043, [[finding_seeded_selfsweep_secondary_surface_rot]], [[finding_closeout_as_writeback_tail]].

Pattern: A SPLIT-BORN SYNTHESIS ROLE LACKS A SPAWN DRIVER: theater/domain siblings get event-spawned, but the synthesis agent's trigger ('both siblings moved') has no owner — the role's validation gate becomes structurally unfireable while its inbox accretes the raw material it exists to synthesize.
Evidence: HAWK post-7/12 re-cut: zero sessions in 10d, spec-§6 synthesis pass never run, 21 unconsumed inbox items (incl. PROME's 7/21 both-theaters insurance-constraint datum = exactly a cross-war synthesis input); OSPREY/FALCON meanwhile event-spawned repeatedly.
Notes: FIX: at split/re-cut time, register the synthesis role's spawn cadence in a durable home (PROME docket row or registry) — PAT-041's cadence-homing rule lifted from tool level to AGENT level. Extends PAT-049 (split specs blind on operational periphery). Applied: HAWK sunset clause armed (no pass by ~8/1 = L4->L3), PROME flagged to spawn at FAL-01/OSP-01 resolution week.

Pattern: NEWBORN/PROMOTED-AGENT SURFACES FOSSILIZE AT BUILD VINTAGE WITHIN DAYS: instruction files keep 'when X is built' language after X ships (CLAUDE.md rot), and promotion-scaffolded accrual ledgers stay 0-row while facts land in STATUS/reports (parent-era habit survives the promotion). Both are the PAT-043 decay shape compressed into week one of an agent's life.
Evidence: MIDAS CLAUDE.md:33/186 'when metals_watch is built' 5d after built+wired; WATT CLAUDE.md:31 lists 3 of 5 power_watch legs; HOMER KB_LIVE.tsv + board_log.tsv 0 rows 10d post-promotion while STATUS/reports accrued.
Notes: FIX (companion closing step to PAT-048): when a flagged first-increment lands, sweep the 'when built' language IN THE SAME SESSION; at promotion, first-boot mandate includes 'start the scaffold ledgers or retire them' (two-state rule from day 1). Grading check: newborn reads diff instruction text against shipped instruments.

Pattern: FROZEN-FRAME EXECUTE-ONLY PRINT GRADING = EMERGENT FLEET STANDARD, with one recurring failure mode: the delivery contract stamps narrative surfaces (card/STATUS/outbox) but OMITS the predictions LEDGER leg, so the TSV stays OPEN while every prose surface says resolved.
Evidence: Convergent independent adoption: REGINALD (ZION 5/5 + WAL two-stage w/ W1-W13 pins), BRENT (COT off raw f_disagg + $85x3 tree), BOND (BND-11/12 + 7/22-23 pre-regs frozen), OZK (frozen card + adversarial Z1-Z10 + two-stage + Brier). Failure mode live at OZK: Stage-1 graded 4 rows 7/21, PREDICTIONS.tsv all still OPEN, delivery contract (card:179) names card+STATUS but not the TSV.
Notes: Blueprint §5 enrichment candidate (pre-registration card + disambiguation addendum + two-stage grade + pre-staged next stage). RULE: every grading contract MUST name the ledger write-back leg explicitly. Instance of [[finding_ledger_drift_behind_narrative]] in pre-registered form; relates PAT-032, PAT-044.

Pattern: CONSUMER-RUN INSTRUMENTS MUTATE THE OWNER'S COMMITTED STATE: a boot-homed watch script executed by a CONSUMER agent (or its session) silently dirties the owner's state JSON in the shared tree — uncommitted residue that reads as the owner's sloppiness and races the owner's next commit.

Pattern: A DEFAULT-ZERO INSTRUMENT CANNOT FALSIFY — it can only false-confirm the null. A falsifier feed whose unfilled state is indistinguishable from a measured zero (a manual-check stub that emits 0s when nobody runs it) silently converts 'nobody looked' into 'nothing happened'; the prediction it instruments appears on-track BY CONSTRUCTION. Worse than stale: INVERTED — it records the opposite of the reality its own STATUS documents. Every falsification instrument must make absence-of-measurement distinguishable from measured-absence (run-stamp + fail-loud/PARTIAL state); a zero is only valid when accompanied by evidence the check ran.

Pattern: A SEEDED HANDLE CAN COLLAPSE OPPOSITE-SIGNED SUB-MECHANISMS INTO ONE NUMBER — a standup-drafted composite score, defensible on its own label, can average a disconfirmed leg against an intensifying one; a cross-agent reader taking the one-line composite reads 'thesis mostly died' when half of it is firing. Pattern: A PARSED DOCUMENT'S FORMAT IS AN INTERFACE — A RE-BASE OR SCHEMA MIGRATION IS A BREAKING CHANGE TO EVERY FORMAT-CONSUMER, AND THE BREAK IS SILENT-BLANK NOT LOUD. Regex/frontmatter parsers key on formatting details (bold placement, blank-line-after-heading, quote chars, field names) that a formatting-only re-base legitimately changes; the parser then returns EMPTY not ERROR, and empty renders as 'quiet day'. Before re-basing any machine-parsed surface, grep for its consumers and re-run them against the new format; every parser of a peer surface needs an emptiness assertion ('N sections parsed >= 1') to convert silent blank into loud failure.

Pattern: A SHARED SURFACE WITH NO OWNING AGENT ACCUMULATES EVERY DEFECT CLASS THE FLEET HAS MECHANISMS FOR, BECAUSE EVERY MECHANISM IS SCOPED TO THE OWNERSHIP UNIT. The discriminator is NOT 'lives outside AGENTS/' — it is 'outside AGENTS/ AND no owner-side mechanism.' Pattern: A COMPOUND GATE MUST BE BASE-RATED CONDITIONAL ON ITS OWN TRIGGER STATE, NOT UNCONDITIONALLY — AND THE SILENT VERSION IS THE KILL-SIDE ONE. Legs that are individually healthy and JOINTLY healthy in the average state can be jointly IMPOSSIBLE in the only state that matters, when a leg's semantics negate the trigger's semantics (calm-state leg + escalation trigger). The cheap screen needs no data: write the trigger's semantic clause and each leg's clause side by side; if any leg is the negation/precondition/calm-form of the trigger, it is a candidate. Generalized form (BRENT): ANY METRIC MEASURING 'THE MOVE HASN'T HAPPENED YET' IS 0% ON DAYS THE MOVE IS HAPPENING. Three distinct defects: D1 trigger-conditional unsatisfiability; D2 joint improbability (near-independent rare legs in one window); D3 non-discriminating veto (fires identically in true and false worlds). DIRECTION SETS SEVERITY: a broken DEPLOY gate is loud (capital sits, someone asks why); a broken KILL / STAND-DOWN / RETIRE gate is SILENT, because a kill that cannot fire is indistinguishable from a thesis that is still true. FIX-FORM = the armed-but-never-opened counter, not a sweep: a gate does not rot on a calendar, it is defective at specification time; count sessions armed-and-unopened and presume defect past the arm's expiry (count the PLAIN arm — a counter gated on 'armed AND still relevant' is itself a compound gate and inherits D1). FOURTH TYPE, FOUND IN THE SCREEN ITSELF — D4 ASYMMETRIC ARM/DISARM: a state machine with a DISJUNCTIVE entry and a CONJUNCTIVE exit is a RATCHET, and P(enter) >> P(exit) holds FOR ANY LEGS AT ALL, correlated or independent. No base rate needed; it is arithmetic on the connectives. TEST: count the connectives on the way IN and on the way OUT — disjunctive-in/conjunctive-out is the defect; symmetric or reversed is the conservative shape. D4 is the cheapest of the four tests, needs zero domain knowledge, and is invisible to BOTH leg-level and joint base-rating because the defect is not inside either clause — it lives in the RELATIONSHIP between two gates (VIOLET's sit 5 lines apart).

Pattern: A SPLIT SEEDS THE CHILDREN'S BLIND SPOTS, AND A MISSING ROW IS SILENT IN A WAY INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM THE EVENT NOT HAPPENING. Three seeding defects, all invisible from inside the child: (1) MECHANISM ROWS ALLOCATED BY WHERE THEIR INSTANCES HAPPENED, NOT WHERE THE MECHANISM CAN FIRE — a pathway's historical examples are evidence, the mechanism is the asset, and it is usually domain-agnostic; a universal mechanism must be COPIED to both children, not assigned to one (duplication is correct here, not redundant). Build-time test = one question per non-migrated row: 'can this mechanism fire in that child's theater?'. (2) ** THE SEVERE ONE ** NO ROW-SHAPE FOR A WHOLE CLASS OF SHOCK — the parent's rows all ran through one channel, so both children inherited the same hole; 'that belongs to another agent' and 'I am blind to it' LOOK IDENTICAL FROM OUTSIDE and only one is safe. NO DILIGENCE INSIDE THE AGENT RECOVERS THIS: REPRODUCIBILITY DOES NOT TEST SCOPE MATCH — the ledger can be current, the arithmetic right, the base rate freshly re-derived, and the instrument still blind. Build-time test = 'name a shock in this domain that NONE of the seeded rows has a row-shape for'; if the answer isn't 'none', seed the row OR WRITE THE EXCLUSION DOWN AND NAME ITS OWNER, so the blind spot cannot hide behind the boundary. (3) FILES TABLES WRITTEN IN STATE TENSE age invisibly because nobody re-reads a FILES table against the files; discriminator = PROVENANCE statements are permanently true ('seeded from HAWK, IDs kept'), QUANTITY statements decay silently as the file grows, POINTER statements decay DANGEROUSLY (aiming a boot-read at a superseded artifact). Point at the resolution rule (newest-dated file; the artifact's own header), never at a value someone must maintain.

Pattern: AUDIT A CHECK BY WHAT ITS PASS MEANS, NOT BY WHAT ITS FAILURE MEANS. For every guard ask: is 'nothing to report' distinguishable from 'did not look'? — and separately, does the guard's boundary include the period that is still actionable? Pattern: AN AGENT THAT DOCUMENTS ITS OWN WORKFLOW WHILE ITS CHARTER IS IN DRAFT CREATES A COMPETING CHARTER — AND FOR A HANDED-CONTEXT AGENT THERE IS NO TIE-BREAK, BECAUSE WHICHEVER DOCUMENT IT IS HANDED *IS* ITS CHARTER THAT RUN. The gap between drafting a spec and ratifying it is a window in which the subject can self-specify. That is usually GOOD (the self-authored half is often better than the architect's — here it supplied the disposition vocabulary and close-condition rule the charter lacked) and the defect is not the content: it is TWO LIVE ANSWERS TO ONE QUESTION with no precedence header. Severity is set by the BOOT MODEL, not by how far the docs diverge: a Claude Code agent auto-loads one CLAUDE.md and the competing doc is merely stale, but an agent that is HANDED its context has no canonical loader, so both docs are equally 'live' and the governing one is chosen by whoever pastes it. Fix-form: at ratification, RECONCILE rather than override — name each divergence, rule per divergence, ADOPT-BY-REFERENCE what the self-authored doc does better (never copy it: one home per fact), and write a precedence line into the doc the subject is actually handed. Detection: at every registration, grep for docs ABOUT the new agent that the new agent wrote itself, outside its own dir.

Pattern: A FRESHNESS RULE IS VALID FOR EXACTLY ONE SURFACE KIND, AND A SCANNER COVERING BOTH KINDS NEEDS TWO RULES PLUS A DISCRIMINATOR. STATE surfaces (thesis, validation doc, exit protocol, kill memo) DESCRIBE a present state, so their vintage is the HEADER'S OWN LABELLED CLAIM — their newest interior date is typically an EVENT date sitting inside a criterion. APPEND-ONLY surfaces (changelogs, decision logs, TSV ledgers) ACCRUE, so their vintage is their NEWEST ENTRY — and for a markdown changelog that means the newest ENTRY HEADING, never the newest date anywhere in the body, because prose inside an entry cites later events than the entry itself. Third kind, third rule: an EVENT log (fires only when the world acts) has NO expected cadence at all — its age measures the world, not the surface, so age is not a staleness signal and flagging it punishes a correctly-quiet ledger. ★ THE LOAD-BEARING HALF: getting the kind wrong fails in BOTH DIRECTIONS, and a fix aimed at one direction CREATES the other. Fix-form: classify the surface KIND before computing its age, and state the kind in the output so a reader can see which rule was applied.

Pattern: A PACKET ROUTED TO A DARK AGENT YIELDS ZERO, RELIABLY — and dark-period risk is a function of INBOUND CORRECTION VOLUME, not commit count. The packet is now a durable false claim sitting in someone else's inbox — the same shape as the false-preservation claims I had catalogued in RED, CARL and HENRY hours earlier (text asserting an artifact state that is not true), committed by the agent who catalogued them. The enabling condition is that my whole closeout battery — orphan_check, claim_check, memory_index_check, safe-push — answers ONE question, 'did the files reach origin?', and none answers 'did the work the session claimed to do actually get done?' A session can therefore pass every check while leaving promised registrations, unresolved reader caveats, standard-changes-missing-from-EVOLUTION and unserviced queue rows behind, because all of those are COMPLETE-failures and every check is a COMMITTED-check. Measured 8/12: four Will questions surfaced eight gaps behind my own 'closed'; my closeout found zero of them. Fix-form: any verb in a packet asserting a side effect (logged / registered / queued / filed / wired) is a PROMISE — grep the named surface for it before the packet ships, and re-grep at closeout. Generalization: audit your checks by WHAT THEY CERTIFY, not by whether they pass (PAT-074 one layer up).

Pattern: TWO OUTPUT SURFACES LET 'CAPTURED' MASQUERADE AS 'ACTIONED' — A FINDING FILED IN THE COMPREHENSION LAYER IS NOT ROUTED TO THE OWNER. The 8/12 RED fan-out fed BOTH a profile (durable comprehension) and a packet (the owner's fix-list). Six reader findings landed in the profile and never reached the packet — including one the reader had ranked #4 on its OWN top-5 routing list (RED's outbox/ has no delivered/ convention, a 25-of-36 fleet standard, on a lane that is receipt-less by construction so the ambiguity class cannot be closed any other way). Nothing was lost and every item was retrievable, which is exactly why it survived four completeness passes: I deduped against 'did I capture this?' instead of 'did this reach the owner?', and a finding sitting in the durable layer READS as handled. Distinct from PAT-100 (evidence dying with the session) — here the evidence lived and the ROUTING died. Fix-form: when a fan-out feeds more than one output surface, reconcile the owner-facing one against each reader's own ranked route list, item by item, and treat the reader's ranking as the checklist — the readers had already sorted their findings by what needed routing, and the ranking was the artifact I failed to use.

Pattern: A TOOL WHOSE DEPS LIVE ONLY IN .venv WHILE ITS DOCUMENTED RECIPE SAYS BARE python3 IS A LATENT INSTRUMENT FAILURE — and the dangerous subclass CATCHES the missing import and CONTINUES, so the session succeeds while the data leg silently drops. VULCAN's semi_watch.py wrote 8x ERR:yfinance-missing rows under bare python3 (the documented invocation in its own USAGE block, boot.py's printed recipe AND CLAUDE.md) and dropped its entire equity leg — the leg its most recent score change rested on. Fail-loud protects the DATA, not the SESSION: an honest ERR row is still a dropped leg downstream. FIX AT THE TOOL, never the docs — the next reader invokes from memory or a spawn packet, so doc fixes don't close the class: self re-exec under the repo .venv on venv-only import failure, env-guarded against loops, loud error if no venv.
Evidence: VULCAN L-16 / KB-VULCAN-088 (2026-08-13, packet to DAEDALUS). Fleet measurement 2026-08-15: 39 scripts import yfinance (venv-only on this box, ModuleNotFoundError verified under bare python3); protection spectrum = doc-only (BRENT thresholds: usage-string prescribes .venv/bin/python3, no re-exec) -> catch-and-continue (the dangerous subclass) -> true re-exec (semi_watch post-fix; scripts/market.py fixed 8/15 same pass).
Notes: Sibling of PAT-031 (cwd-proof) — same family: documented invocation must match runtime reality; cwd was the first axis, interpreter/env is the second. Encoded in market-agent.md hygiene lane 8/15. Loud-crash cohort (top-level import, no try/except) self-announces rc=1 and is NOT worth per-agent packets; the catch-and-continue subclass is the one to hunt at profile/upgrade touches.

Pattern: A BLANK-PANEL GUARD CERTIFIES NONEMPTINESS, NOT TRUTH — parser rot that leaves a NONEMPTY value is invisible to it, and content-INVERSION is the worst subclass: a wrong headline outranks a blank one because nothing reads as broken. Pattern: A FALLBACK INVISIBLE IN THE OUTPUT IS A SILENT SUBSTITUTION, AND THE GREEN CHECK CERTIFIES THE RUN NEVER THE PULL — measured fleet-wide: 16 of 41 fetch scripts CLASS-HIT (fallback/cache/empty-dict serves data or a VERDICT rendered identically to fresh success, rc=0). Three sub-forms, each defeating a different guard: (a) warning exists on stderr/docstring/--verbose while stdout+artifact+rc stay green — 9 wrappers DELETE stderr on rc==0, so the honest signal is unrescuable by any marker whitelist; (b) loud error in the BODY + rc=0 under a wrapper whose summary verdict keys on rc alone (10 of 22 wrappers) — the reassuring line sits beside what the operator reads; (c) INVERTED form: a fetch failure rendered as a data VERDICT ('no auction found', 'status quo holding', '999.0x put-heavy from a missing column') — the most dangerous, a negative reads as reassurance. 3 hits also OVERWRITE their artifact with the degraded result, persisting the lie past the run.
Evidence: SFG sweep 2026-08-17 (4-reader fan-out, sweeps/SILENT_FALLBACK_GREEN_SWEEP_2026-08-17.md + upgrades companion). Positive control: EVERY tool built/hardened after a live incident of this class renders correctly (n=10: move/chain_fetch/paper_book_mark/partb/cot_gold/ofr_stfm/h2a_pull/hormuz/form4/marker-quad) — the hits are surfaces awaiting their incident.
Notes: Fix-form (CHECK_STANDARD §8, PROVISIONAL pending Will): served vintage+source-mode in the non-verbose default line AND any written artifact; a distinct nonzero rc for served-but-not-fresh; wrappers relay stderr unconditionally and derive verdicts from marker-present never rc (the 8/16 WATT/VULCAN/MIDAS/FERT contract, verified by execution). Grep tell: 'return {}' / bare 'except: return None|[]' / 'or previousClose' / whitelist-collapse defaulting to green on empty match. | SAM write-back 8/17 (first of the sweep, all 4 ACTIONs verified at source) adds TWO extensions: (1) SEVERITY MULTIPLIER — fallback-to-absence is worst where the consuming thesis treats ABSENCE AS EVIDENCE (SAM's Pillar-2 reads absent 20Y demand as thesis-CONFIRMING, so an outage masquerades as the most thesis-favourable outcome; the same defect is benign where the null is uninformative — score hits by the consumer's null-semantics, not just by frequency); (2) SECOND-CONSUMER RULE — when suppressing a derived verdict, grep the whole file for OTHER renderings of the same derived quantity (a self-calibration/history layer commonly ships a second interpretation string; SAM's regression test caught a still-broken sibling after a passing headline fix). Craft: purge sentinels by PREDICATE (value+cause pair), never by grep-for-the-number — 2 genuine 999-OI rows sat beside the 1 fake 999.0 ratio row. | BRENT write-back 8/17 adds: PREDICATE re-key 'bare continue on an unavailable input' (first run found CARL thresholds.py as an exact shape-twin — the predicate travels); WRAPPER-vs-PRODUCER grade separately (a mute producer — unconditional return 0 — makes the best wrapper a green board); EVIDENCE STANDARD = counterfactual run of the PRE-FIX code under the failure condition (reading proves possible, running proves real; correct cwd or __file__ paths fake a loud failure); defect chains are LINKS not lines (BRENT's was 4 — fixing the named link alone leaves the false-green reachable). | SAM RETRACTION 8/17 (f05e4fed0, verified): founding exhibit cpi_japan NEVER FIRED (key in the second search location; capability read as evidence-of-use) — exemplar SWAPS to jgb_auctions (executed: injected unroutable host). SCOPING RULE the retraction earns: a grep/code-shape CLASS-HIT is a CANDIDATE, not an instance — publish counts as such; only executing the path (BRENT counterfactual standard) makes it an observation. SUB-FORM (d), grep-invisible: SUCCESS-SHAPED EMPTY inside the API contract — a stale identifier against a new table returns 'completed successfully, no data', so a typo is indistinguishable from an empty universe and caller-side rc discipline cannot catch it; after changing ANY identifier, probe live and require non-empty (SAM 2025-base rebase: TWO parameters moved, the second found only by live probe).

Pattern: ENUMERATING AN INSTRUMENT'S CLOCK IS NOT ESTABLISHING IT — establishment = a CONTROL PULL on a known-good prior period (proves the query sound) + a FRONTIER WALK (finds where data actually stops); two API calls. The trap that makes assertion feel sufficient: a WRONG clock model can produce a RIGHT prediction ('Sunday -> posts Monday' correctly predicted absence) and gets FALSELY CONFIRMED on any ordinary day — a coincidence between a wrong model and a right observation is invisible from inside the model; only a control on a period the model says NOTHING about breaks it. Placement corollary (WATT L-33, the self-certifying-exemption shape): the erroneous clock was asserted inside the KB row whose stated purpose was discharging the establish-the-clock clause — quoting the rule and violating it in the same breath.

Owner-offered from its own adjudicated miss w/ worked fix incl. a pre-registered estimator w/ explicit falsifier — the PAT-090 banking shape.
Notes: n=1 but mechanism-general + cheap (2 calls). Adjacent to PAT-106/SFG (a plausible clock is the temporal twin of a plausible green) but distinct: nothing failed silently — the MODEL of the feed was wrong. Pattern: A WRITER WITH NO REGISTERED READER — an autonomous routine that writes+self-commits into an agent's tree while NO boot step reads that path. The desk quotes its older boot bar while a fresher, more complete committed pull sits unread in its OWN directory. A READ-PATH gap, not staleness: ledger_staleness passes (file fresh), SFG/PAT-106 passes (fetch succeeded, output honest) — what is missing is a CONSUMER. Output-consumption is a distinct audit axis from output-honesty; the registration checklist question is symmetric: every registered writer names its reader, every reader its writer (inverse shape same day: BRENT instrument_check probe verdicts persist NOWHERE — a reader whose findings have no writer).

Pattern: TWO CONTRADICTORY BINDINGS IN ONE FILE — THE LATER OR STRONGER ONE SILENTLY WINS, AND EVERY PROSE CLAIM POINTS AT THE LOSER. Two same-day live instances, opposite mechanisms, one shape: (a) SHADOWING-REASSIGNMENT — BRENT thresholds.py bound FRED_THRESHOLDS from REGISTRY.tsv at L127 then re-bound the same name to a hardcoded literal at L138; docstring + header comment both said the literal was GONE, so a grep for 'hardcoded table removed' finds the removal CLAIM and the literal coexisting; the 8/12 registry relabel and the same-morning false-green fix both landed on the losing side. (b) EXCLUDE-BEATS-INCLUDE — my falsification_scan.py named COUNTER_THESIS.md in SURFACE_PATTERNS while EXCLUDE carried the bare token `red`, so the include rule lost silently and a 48d-stale adversarial rail vanished from sweep #3. Grep tell: multiple assignments of one load-bearing name (`grep -n '^NAME\s*='` expecting exactly 1); any include-list whose members can also match an exclude-list — test each include member against the excluder.
Evidence: BRENT bb0f1749f (verified row-by-row 10==10 pre-delete, A/B counterfactual zero-delta) + DAEDALUS falsification_scan fix same session (7 unit cases watched, red/COUNTER_THESIS now prints STALE-FLAGGED 44d — the line sweep #3 missed). Both found by the 8/17 SAM/BRENT structure review readers.
Notes: Fix-form: one binding per load-bearing name; when a canonical-source binding replaces a literal, DELETE the literal in the same commit and leave a dated deletion comment (BRENT's form). Audit predicate joins bare-continue (PAT-106 family) in the 8/31 uptake pass. Related: finding_record_of_an_action_is_not_the_action (the prose said gone; the code said otherwise).

Pattern: An "alert, not a gate" always-0 exit contract on a SHARED check is a standing silent-fallback-green exposure: every rc-keyed consumer renders OK over real findings, and the safety rationale ("wiring it cannot break a boot") optimizes the wrong failure direction — safe-to-wire traded for silent-green. Pattern: A MANDATED BOOT-READ SET LARGER THAN THE READ INSTRUMENT'S CAP SILENTLY DEGRADES EVERY BOOT TO FRAGMENTS — the protocol stays written, execution quietly becomes greps, and 'apply prior lessons' cannot run against a file that cannot be read whole. Measure boot files against the READ CAP, not only against byte budgets; the failure is invisible because partial reads still produce plausible sessions. Triple same-day evidence: a reader measured STATUS at ~49KB (the signature of its own truncated read — the defect measuring itself); a second covered 11-of-40 FLEET_MAP rows; the audit's own commissioning boot truncated STATUS at line 66/134 and never read FLEET_MAP or PATTERNS whole. Fix-form = hot/cold split (the auto-memory 7/31 pattern): boot reads a GENERATED one-line index, the cold file keeps full rows, conservation-checked at every regen.
Evidence: Self-audit F37 (PROME-additive; verified wc=424,714 B across STATUS+FLEET_MAP+PATTERNS, all 1.9-3.2x over cap); fixed same day: PATTERNS_HOT.md (111==111 conservation) + FLEET_MAP_HISTORY.tsv (170KB->51.5KB live) + STATUS rotation (100KB->25.6KB, 4 crc-stamped blocks -> archive/STATUS_ARCHIVE_2026-08-17.md)
Notes: Companion to PAT-086 (byte-bloat under a satisfied line cap) — different mechanism: 086 is growth evasion, 111 is read-instrument arithmetic. See also PAT-050 (self-application). Fleet generalization = the ~8/28 boot-arithmetic sweep columns (six-ideas #2, pending ruling).

Pattern: A COORDINATOR-DRIVEN SESSION WRITES CONTENT INTO A DESK WITHOUT RUNNING THE OWNER'S CLOSEOUT, SO THE DATED HEADER NO LONGER COVERS ITS NEWEST BODY CONTENT — the body outran its own header (wording tightened 2026-08-17 at PROME's catch: the packet's 'header post-dates its body' read inverted). The closeout step that re-cuts BOTTOM LINE / the vintage stamp belongs to the OWNER's boot protocol; a proxy session (forum slate, coordinator commit) runs the content legs and skips the owner's closeout by construction. Downstream: every reader reads a synthesis header asserting a state the body below it has already left; and ledger-staleness git-time fallbacks get re-armed by the same commits. Fix-form: a proxy session either re-cuts the owner's header or stamps the commit 'content-only, owner closeout owed' — and the owner's next boot treats that stamp as a due item.
Evidence: PR#4 2026-08-17, n=4 in one afternoon (8/10 forum slate): VIOLET 4 gate rows written, header still 8/04 · HENRY HEN-41/H-1/H-2/HEN-43 written, stamps [8/6] · LIQUID Tests A/B/C+T11+T6 written, BOTTOM LINE [7/29] · BOND BND-01 resolved 15d LATE because the proxy session never ran the closeout write-back. Distinct from PAT-089 (unlogged fire): this is a write outrunning its header.
Notes: Ask routed to PROME at PR#4: rule for proxy sessions (re-cut or stamp content-only). See also PAT-092 (dark-desk relative clocks), finding_hygiene_commit_rearms_the_staleness_lie. · ENCODED by PROME same hour as playbook Operating discipline #7 (f80c2ca25), rule hardened to either/or: re-cut owner vintage OR stamp content-only, never neither.

Pattern: AN ENCODE-EXISTING HANDLE INSTALLED AS CONTENT ON A REGENERATED SURFACE DIES AT THE NEXT REGENERATION UNLESS IT IS WIRED INTO THE REGENERATOR — and the register keeps certifying it because the apply was verified ONCE, at install time. WALTER's ## BOTTOM LINE: installed 7/11 (Sweep A/B), deleted by WALTER's own 7/23 Tier-2 spine regeneration, absent 25 days across every subsequent regen, while the FLEET_MAP row asserted it 'grep-verified' and zero occurrences of the handle's NAME existed in WALTER's own closeout protocol. One-command durability check, run AT APPLY TIME: grep the recipient's own closeout/regeneration protocol for the handle's name — absent means the install is content, not contract, and will not survive. Also indicts the write-back tail: the FLEET_MAP leg was closed, the durability leg never opened.
Evidence: PR#4 2026-08-17 (pr4-walter reader): install 96d4de066 (7/11) -> deletion 945f201ae (7/23, literal '-## BOTTOM LINE' in diff, synthesizer-verified) -> 25d dark. Notes: Fix routed to WALTER: a NAMED step in the Tier-2 closeout protocol, never a content re-install. Sibling to PAT-055/PAT-094; see PAT-032.

Pattern: A PRACTICE/VERIFICATION INSTRUMENT GETS BUILT AGAINST THE BEST AVAILABLE EXEMPLAR, NOT AGAINST THE CONFIRMED REQUIREMENT — and the instrument's EXCELLENCE at what it does test is precisely what conceals the gap. VIRGIL's mock_datavault is a genuinely strong 4-level progressive mock (66 cases, validated) — but the ONE confirmed fact about the target assessment is 'Filesystem: work with MULTIPLE FILES', and the mock is one class in one file whose conftest.py pre-solves path resolution, so it cannot exercise the documented #3 prep priority (cross-directory imports) at all. The only instrument that did (filesystem_practice.zip) was recorded MISSING on the same surface that called it 'functionally superseded' by the mock — the coverage claim and the evidence against it sat 25 lines apart, unconnected. TEST: for each CONFIRMED requirement, name the instrument that exercises it; a requirement whose only instrument is missing/absent is UNCOVERED however good the other instruments are. Coverage is measured against the SPEC, never against the strongest thing you built.
Evidence: VIRGIL architecture review 2026-08-19 (Will-requested). mock_datavault/src = 1 file 1 class + conftest.py inserting src/ on sys.path; ASSESSMENT_STATE.md:31 Confirmed 'work with multiple files', prep priority #3 = 'resolving cross-directory imports', :377 zip NOT FOUND while :349 called the mock a functional replacement. Fix shipped same session: mock_ledger/ — 3 modules, real cross-module imports, NO conftest, 66 cases validated both directions (66/66 ref pass, 66/66 stub fail), bare-pytest-vs-python-m-pytest divergence verified live.
Notes: Generalizes past VIRGIL: the same shape is how a fleet check ends up covering the surfaces it was easy to enumerate rather than the ones the requirement names. Pairs with PAT-074 (audit by what the PASS proves) — this is the upstream question: does the instrument SET cover the requirement SET? Cheap discriminator: write the requirement list and the instrument list as two columns and join them; an unjoined requirement is the finding. Also note the near-miss guard that did NOT fire: the state file's own Confirmed/Inferred tiering was healthy, so the defect was not bad epistemics — it was never asking which artifact discharged which confirmed line.
